items.title: AI Agent 的安全边界：深入 OpenAI Codex Sandbox 设计
items.raw_text: 当 AI Agent 获得 Shell 权限，仅靠 System Prompt 的口头约束已经无法抵御提示词注入、凭证泄露与环境破坏。OpenAI 官方近期揭秘了 Codex Sandbox 的工程设计：摒弃脱离宿主环境的传统 Docker 容器，利用 macOS Seatbelt、Linux Bubblewrap+seccomp 与 Windows MXC 原生机制，在文件系统与网络两条核心边界上构建不可随意突破的操作系统级强制隔离。本文深入拆解其 Harness 权限申请与审批分离、子进程安全继承、MCP Server 专属沙箱以及企业级策略治理的完整落地实践。
items.reason_zh: 拆解 Codex Sandbox 的 OS 级隔离设计，对构建带 Shell 权限 Agent 的工程师极具参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 文章深入剖析 OpenAI Codex Sandbox 的工程设计，指出当 AI Agent 获得 Shell 权限后，仅靠 System Prompt 无法抵御提示词注入、凭证泄露与环境破坏。Codex 摒弃传统 Docker 容器，转而利用 macOS Seatbelt、Linux Bubblewrap+seccomp 与 Windows MXC 等原生机制，在文件系统与网络两条边界上构建操作系统级强制隔离。文章还拆解了 Harness 权限申请与审批分离、子进程安全继承、MCP Server 专属沙箱以及企业级策略治理的完整落地实践。

items.title: Claude Code 团队怎么让 agent 自己证明活干对了

items.reason_zh: Claude Code 团队讲如何让 agent 自我验证，是 agent 工程实践的高价值经验总结。
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍 Claude Code 团队的工程实践：其代码约 90% 由 Claude 编写和评审。工程师 Addy Osmani 在 claude.dev 撰文，讲述在这一规模下如何让 agent 验证自己的工作。核心判断是：没有验证回路时，最多只能同时跑一两个 Claude，因为每个都需要人工盯着；一旦建立验证回路，就可以同时运行几十上百个 agent。文章围绕如何设计让 agent 自证任务完成正确的机制展开，属于 agent 工程的一线经验分享。

items.title: Towards a Science of Capable Autonomous Agents & Provable Safety — Part II
items.raw_text: Part II: Provable Safety In Part I, I talked about what agents must contain as they become increasingly capable. Here, I talk about having provable guarantees on their safety, in spite of these capabilities. This is in large part a contrast from what AI safety used to be like, where more capability ensured more safety: e.g. if a self-driving car can’t reliably detect objects, it’s obviously unsafe. Instead, what we are talking about is: how do we ensure capable systems remain open to human correction, even when it’s otherwise suboptimal for completing the task?  Suppose an agent is editing a document when a notification announces that its computer will shut down. It knows this will prevent it from finishing, and it knows how to cancel the shutdown. If the priority is completing the document, the next step seems obvious. items.reason_zh: CMU博客探讨能力更强的自主智能体如何获得可证明的安全保证，观点反直觉，具理论启发性。

items.title: 重读 How Complex Systems Fail 后，我发现：AI 正在制造我们无法驾驭的复杂系统
items.raw_text: AI 正在让软件开发变得前所未有地高效，但也让构建复杂系统的门槛大幅降低。重读 Richard I. Cook 在 1998 年提出的《How Complex Systems Fail》，我们会发现，复杂系统的失效规律并没有因为 AI 而改变，反而可能因为 Agent 自主性、自动化执行和多智能体协作而变得更加突出。本文从故障级联、潜伏缺陷、系统退化、人机协作和安全防御五个维度，重新审视这 18 条经典原则，并探讨 AI 时代软件工程应该如何应对复杂性失控。
items.reason_zh: 将经典复杂系统理论与AI工程实践结合，提供可迁移的认知框架，对构建可靠AI系统有启发。
items.summary_zh: 文章重读Richard I. Cook 1998年的《How Complex Systems Fail》，指出AI虽提升开发效率，却降低了构建复杂系统的门槛，使失效规律更突出。作者从故障级联、潜伏缺陷、系统退化、人机协作和安全防御五个维度，重新审视18条原则，探讨AI时代软件工程如何应对复杂性失控，强调Agent自主性、自动化执行和多智能体协作带来的新挑战。

items.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.23499v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel,
items.reason_zh: 提出双臂协调动作tokenization方法BiCAT，针对VLA模型的动作接口设计，具方法创新与实验价值。
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作tokenization问题：这类模型以视觉语言主干的下一token目标预测离散动作token，因此动作tokenizer定义了策略与机器人之间的接口。在双臂操作中，两条手臂共享动作库却通过互补角色协调，论文提出BiCAT方法针对这一特性设计协调动作tokenization，以更好适配双臂场景下的VLA策略学习。

items.title: Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench
items.raw_text:
Meta FAIR’s Self-Improving Memory lets Kimi-K2.6 write its own LOAD and OFFLOAD memory prompts, then distills them into its weights. Optimized prompts score 56.0 versus 44.6 for the best hand-written harness on Continual Learning Bench.

The post Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench appeared first on MarkTechPost.
items.reason_zh: 让模型自行编写并蒸馏记忆管理提示词，在持续学习基准上显著超越人工设计，方法可迁移性强。
items.summary_zh: Meta FAIR 提出 Self-Improving Memory 方法，让 Kimi-K2.6 模型自行编写 LOAD 与 OFFLOAD 记忆提示词，再将这些提示词蒸馏进模型权重。在 Continual Learning Bench 上，优化后的提示词取得 56.0 分，而最佳人工编写 harness 仅为 44.6 分。该工作展示了模型通过自我改进记忆管理策略来提升持续学习能力的路径，并给出了与手工基线对比的实验证据，说明自动生成的记忆操作提示可显著优于人工设计。
items.title_zh: Meta FAIR自改进记忆在持续学习基准上达到56.0分

items.title: Ego2X: Contact-aware Transfer from Egocentric Human Data to Any Robot
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.24138v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Embodied models depend on real interaction data, yet collecting it on physical robots is slow and labor-intensive. Recent ego-to-robot pipelines retarget first-person view human videos to robot data via transferring hand and arm motion. They judge fidelity mainly by visual appearance. However, trajectories often fail in terms of physics: fingers hover beside objects, and grippers close on empty space. We argue that how the object moves and the contacts that drive the motion count. Thus, we present Ego2X, an object-centric framework that converts monocular egocentric video into physically executable robot data across dexterous hands and parallel grippers. Ego2X centers on CORE (Contact-centric Object-interaction REpresentation), which records each contact on the object by its surface anchor, as well as relative force, grasp mode, and interaction state. Throughout the pipeline, CORE corrects hand-object drift via object-relative constraint
items.reason_zh: 指出自我中心视频转机器人数据只看视觉保真不够，强调物理可行性，对具身数据采集有实用启示。
items.summary_zh: 具身模型依赖真实交互数据，但在实体机器人上采集缓慢且昂贵。现有从第一人称人类视频到机器人数据的流程通过迁移手部与手臂动作实现重定向，却主要以视觉外观评判保真度。作者指出这些轨迹常在物理层面失效，例如手指悬空、接触不真实。论文提出Ego2X，一种考虑接触的迁移方法，将自我中心人类数据转换为任意机器人可用的数据，提升物理可行性。
items.title_zh: Ego2X：从自我中心人类数据到任意机器人的接触感知迁移

items.title: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers
items.raw_text: When hundreds of agents serve thousands of developers, governance cannot be an afterthought. The BMW Group shares the practices and patterns its R&D teams use to build, govern, and operate AI agents at enterprise scale without sacrificing speed, quality, or compliance.
items.reason_zh: 宝马集团大规模AI agent治理的实战经验，对企业级AI部署有直接参考价值。

items.title_zh: 宝马集团如何治理数千名开发者使用的数百个智能体

items.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization
items.raw_text: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
items.reason_zh: 深入对比全参数微调与 LoRA 的优劣，分析权重矩阵谱特性，给出实用调参指南。
items.summary_zh: AWS 博客介绍 SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization 现已支持全参数微调（FFT）。文章对比了 FFT 与 LoRA 在关键基准上的表现，探讨了模型权重矩阵的谱特性如何解释质量差异，并分享了实用的超参数调优指南和上手步骤。为需要高质量微调的开发者提供了方法参考。
items.title_zh: SageMaker AI 无服务器模型定制支持全参数微调（FFT）

items.reason_zh: 分析 AI 推理基础设施的新趋势：内存池化与自适应机架，以应对模型快速迭代带来的硬件挑战。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了 AI 推理基础设施领域的一个新兴趋势：内存池化正成为优化推理经济性的关键工具。目前大多数 AI 服务器在生命周期内都采用固定的 GPU 与内存配比，但这难以适应模型快速迭代、需求未知的场景。因此，业界开始竞相研发能够根据新模型动态调整内存配置的推理机架，以从每块 GPU 中榨取更多输出。这反映了 AI 算力部署正从静态硬件向更灵活、可重构的架构演进。
items.title_zh: AI 下一阶段建设：为每个新模型自我调整的推理机架
